channel.title: Top of the Pops
channel.desc: The vaults are opened up to relive some of the classic and biggest songs of 1992. Featuring the hip hop and dance of Kris Kross, SL2, Bizarre Inc and Felix to the rock stylings of Manic Street Preachers and Primal Scream, as well as the emergence of boy band royalty Take That, Miley's dad Billy Ray getting the line dancing going, divas in the form of Annie Lennox and Mariah Carey, and, of course, Jimmy Nail. Plus many more.
